selection.method: reuse the four accepted native TRAIN rows in stored manifest order; no final or DEV rows

transition_contract.cold_request: exact stored full prompt IDs including manual BOS; cache_prompt=false
transition_contract.cancellation: client closes SSE socket at whole-request deadline; monotonic timestamps recorded
transition_contract.retry: re-tokenize and resend the identical full prompt with cache_prompt=true; retry bound 60000 ms
transition_contract.queue_delay: queued_wait_ms remains unmeasured without correlated server arrival and launch/slot timestamps; any uncorrelated server field is retained only as a hint
transition_contract.server_ack: unmeasured_no_log_correlation unless a separately correlated server log is supplied
transition_contract.output_parity: retry raw text and returned token IDs compared with accepted >=60s native baseline
transition_contract.request_body_policy: only native tokenize fields and completion fields; target/family/labels are never sent

real_editor_transitions.reason: The stored TRAIN histories do not provide an independently hashed before/after pair with exact token geometry. No synthetic edit or invented label is admitted.
real_editor_transitions.next_gate: Capture a genuine editor trace and prove exact before/after token IDs, LCP, and section geometry before adding rows.
